title: floor(IT)
description: shader that floors EVERYTHING except block entities
body:
Takes the vertex coordinate of every block and entity, and floors it, resulting in (one of***)the ugliest Minecraft experience(s) ever.

oh boy q&a time cause my stuff gets rejected if i dont complete the description requirement

- q: 1.: why did you make this?
- a: 1.1: decided i wanted to explore shader creation and the amazing world of glsl
- q: 2.: what does this do
- a: 2.1: look at the screenshots or previous parts of the description
- q: 3.: will you backport or upda-
- a: 3.1: NO.
- q: 3.2: please? what if i ask nicely
- a: 3.3: absolutely not this is a proof of concept (or whatever fancy word) and it is not meant to be treated like a normal shader
- q: 4.: can you end the q&a now
- a: 4.1: ok sure bye
